lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Hi! Good morning. I'm Emma. I just moved in. I live on the fifth floor. What's your name?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 좋은 아침이에요. 저는 엠마예요. 막 이사 왔어요. 5층에 살아요. 이름이 뭐예요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: My name is Hyunju. Nice to meet you.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Nice to meet you too, Hyunju! That's a pretty name. Which floor do you live on?
lines.ko: 저도 반가워요, 현주 씨! 예쁜 이름이네요. 몇 층에 사세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I live on the fifteenth floor.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Oh, the fifteenth floor! You must have a great view! I'm new here. I don't know this area well. Is there a good supermarket near here?
lines.ko: 아, 15층이요! 전망이 정말 좋겠네요! 여기 처음이라 동네를 잘 몰라요. 근처에 괜찮은 슈퍼마켓이 있나요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, there is a supermarket across the road.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Across the road? Oh, that's very close! Thank you so much. I love cooking. Do you like cooking too, Hyunju?
lines.ko: 길 건너편이요? 아주 가깝네요! 정말 고마워요. 저는 요리를 좋아해요. 현주 씨도 요리 좋아하세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I like cooking, but I'm not good at it. I like homemade meals.
lines.ko: 네, 요리는 좋아하는데 잘하지는 못해요. 집밥을 좋아해요.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Me too! Homemade food is the best. Don't worry, cooking is easy with practice! What's your favorite food? What do you like to eat at home?
lines.ko: 저도요! 집밥이 최고죠. 걱정 마세요, 하다 보면 쉬워져요! 제일 좋아하는 음식이 뭐예요? 집에서 뭘 즐겨 드세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I usually make pasta at home. It's easy to make, and I can put so many things in it.
lines.ko: 집에서는 보통 파스타를 만들어요. 만들기 쉽고, 여러 가지를 넣을 수 있거든요.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Pasta! I love pasta too! You can put vegetables, meat, or seafood in it. So good! Oh, this is my floor. It was nice talking to you, Hyunju! See you around!
lines.ko: 파스타! 저도 정말 좋아해요! 채소, 고기, 해산물 다 넣을 수 있죠. 너무 맛있어요! 아, 제 층이에요. 얘기 즐거웠어요, 현주 씨! 또 봐요!

vocab.example: There is a supermarket across the road.
